entries.usage:
- People from the import stand on the form's list like others: in the “Entries” tab (marked “no link”), in the “Table”, on the “Attendance list” of tasks with dates and in the page modules “List of people” and “Person panel”.
- Records from "records" stand in the extension's sheet, period by period — with history, summary, “Print list” and “Download CSV”.
- Only the form's coordinators open the answers; whoever runs the page but does not read the answer area sees only that there are records. The CSV from the “Table” and the export of this JSON contain decrypted answers — nothing protects such a file any more.
- An added person does not see their entry, does not fill in sub-forms, gets neither participant roles ("memberRoles") nor a one-to-one conversation; the office ticks their steps, tasks and attendance, and a person area from "virtualAreas" (if the form has one) serves only the office.
- The import does not ring: the bell and notifications count only entries sent by the people themselves. It also works on a closed form.
entries.descTitle: List of people of the form “{name}” as JSON ("{format}", version 1)
entries.descIntro:
What the import does here: it ADDS people to this form's list and CHANGES the details of people already on it; in extensions filled in by the coordinator it adds and changes records (separately for each period). It deletes nothing. Everything is sealed in this browser before it reaches the service.
- A person with an "id" from the export is changed. A person without an "id" is created new — unless there is exactly one person with the same first name and surname on the list: then it is them.
- Only the answers that are in the document are changed; the rest stays.
- The import does not change the answers of a person who signed up themselves and has their own link.
- An added person has no link of their own — the coordinator looks after them.
